title: What Each Estimate Type Includes: Inspection Scope and Turnaround (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
The work performed before an estimate is written, and the time within which the written estimate is delivered, differ by Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate type as follows.

| Estimate type | Turnaround (business days) | Teardown performed | Teardown labor included (hours) | Structural measurement report | Pre-repair diagnostic scan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 1 | No | 0.0 | No | No |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0 | No | 0.0 | No | No |
| Scheduled Estimate | 0 | No | 0.0 | No | Yes |
| Mobile Estimate | 0 | No | 0.0 | No | No |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 2 | Yes | 3.0 | No | Yes |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 3 | Yes | 6.0 | Yes | Yes |

## Scope definitions

- **Turnaround** — the business days (Monday to Friday, excluding network holidays) after the photos or the check-in within which the written estimate is delivered; 0 means the same day.
- **Teardown performed** — whether the type disassembles damaged areas to find hidden damage before the estimate is written.
- **Teardown labor included** — the disassembly labor included in the teardown, in hours to one decimal.
- **Structural measurement report** — whether an electronic three-dimensional structural measurement report is produced.
- **Pre-repair diagnostic scan** — whether a pre-repair diagnostic scan of the vehicle modules is performed.

## Comparing the two teardown types

| | Blueprint Teardown Estimate | Structural Blueprint Estimate |
|---|---|---|
| Teardown labor included | 3.0 hours | 6.0 hours |
| Structural measurement report | No | Yes |
| Turnaround | 2 business days | 3 business days |

Hypothetical reading: a Photo Estimate whose photo set arrives on a Monday has its written estimate due within 1 business day, by the Tuesday where that Tuesday is not a network holiday.
